nodes.label: Language Tree Hub
nodes.subject: language-tree-hub
nodes.summary: English open knowledge center for intent, lexicon, grammar, semantic abstraction, lateral association, expression and validation.

nodes.label: Multi-path Lateral Association
nodes.subject: language-tree-hub
nodes.summary: Generate several candidate routes from the Language Tree and rank them by FAME, risk, budget and validation hooks.

nodes.label: Abstraction Transfer Landing
nodes.subject: language-tree-hub
nodes.summary: Raise concrete tasks to method and subject layers, transfer verifiable structure laterally, then return to minimal action.

nodes.label: Logic
nodes.subject: logic
nodes.summary: Provides argument analysis, proof obligations, counterexamples, consistency checks and failure diagnosis for agents.

nodes.label: Logical Tool Precheck
nodes.subject: logic
nodes.summary: Checks goal, premise, schema, scope, side effect and validation method before tool use.

nodes.label: Failure Diagnosis Logic
nodes.subject: logic
nodes.summary: Splits a failure into observed facts, hypotheses, distinguishing tests, repairs and FAME update candidates.

nodes.label: Knowledge Authoring Consistency
nodes.subject: logic
nodes.summary: Constrains knowledge additions by subject level, abstraction level, source, license and FAME rationale.

nodes.label: Mathematics
nodes.subject: mathematics
nodes.summary: Provides formalization, modeling, graph traversal, scoring, uncertainty handling and optimization.

nodes.label: Graph Traversal Goal Gate
nodes.subject: mathematics
nodes.summary: Finds candidate knowledge routes by scope, edge budget, FAME score, risk and context budget.

nodes.label: Evidence-driven Parameter Update
nodes.subject: mathematics
nodes.summary: Updates FAME parameters from tests, tool results, human feedback and failure examples.

nodes.label: Route Scoring and Optimization
nodes.subject: mathematics
nodes.summary: Compares route candidates by effectiveness, fit, confidence, novelty, risk and context pressure.

nodes.label: Computer Science
nodes.subject: computer-science
nodes.summary: Provides software engineering, systems, data, AI, security, HCI and open-source governance knowledge.

nodes.label: Specification to Test
nodes.subject: computer-science
nodes.summary: Turns goals into observable behavior, acceptance criteria and evidence-backed tests.

nodes.label: Knowledge Graph and Index Engineering
nodes.subject: computer-science
nodes.summary: Combines light graph, content database, alias index, semantic index and scoped search.

nodes.label: Agent Project Memory Loop
nodes.subject: computer-science
nodes.summary: Stores real implementation traces, tool evidence, lessons and resume points outside core knowledge.

nodes.label: Open-source Release Gate
nodes.subject: computer-science
nodes.summary: Checks license, sources, secrets, docs, edition health and residual risk before release.

nodes.label: Agent Tooling
nodes.subject: agent-tooling
nodes.summary: Governs tool description reading, schema checks, approvals, execution, summaries and failure recurrence prevention.

nodes.label: Action Template Selection
nodes.subject: agent-tooling
nodes.summary: Chooses the right ProposedAction template by operation type and risk.

nodes.label: Tool Gateway Policy Execution
nodes.subject: agent-tooling
nodes.summary: Applies doc-first, proposal, approval and result-summary policies.

nodes.label: Reflection Iteration and Failure Write-back
nodes.subject: agent-tooling
nodes.summary: Turns failures and corrections into recurrence guards and negative FAME lessons.

nodes.label: Agent Usability Evaluation
nodes.subject: agent-tooling
nodes.summary: Measures whether the system makes agents easier to connect and less error-prone.

nodes.label: PowerShell Safety
nodes.subject: powershell-safety
nodes.summary: Reduces Windows shell mistakes around parsing, quoting, paths, recursion, streams and encoding.

nodes.label: PowerShell Command Review Flow
nodes.subject: powershell-safety
nodes.summary: Reviews command shape, path resolution, pipeline and side effects before execution.

nodes.label: Negative FAME Lesson Route
nodes.subject: agent-tooling
nodes.summary: Preserves failed or conflicting routes as visible lessons instead of deleting them.

nodes.label: Project Memory Overlay
nodes.subject: project-memory
nodes.summary: Keeps implementation memory separate from reusable core knowledge.

nodes.label: Thinking Layer Selection
nodes.subject: language-tree-hub
nodes.summary: Selects the right abstraction layer before traversal or execution.

nodes.label: Semantic Adaptation and Term Normalization
nodes.subject: language-tree-hub
nodes.summary: Maps user wording, aliases and tool names to canonical terms.

nodes.label: Text Directory Index
nodes.subject: language-tree-hub
nodes.summary: Provides expandable subject indexes synchronized with graph edits.

nodes.label: One-shot Tool Use
nodes.subject: agent-tooling
nodes.summary: Reads tool manuals at call time and retains only summaries to protect context.

nodes.label: Self-set Clock and Reminder
nodes.subject: agent-tooling
nodes.summary: Schedules checkpoints and resume prompts for long-running tasks.

nodes.label: Mechanism Enforcement
nodes.subject: agent-tooling
nodes.summary: Makes route, action contract, approval and result summary checks difficult for an agent to skip.

nodes.label: Database and Knowledge-net Sync
nodes.subject: agent-tooling
nodes.summary: Keeps multimodal and detailed data in databases while the graph keeps light previews and refs.

nodes.label: Goal Gate Backcasting
nodes.subject: language-tree-hub
nodes.summary: Works backward from success criteria, evidence and forbidden outcomes to a minimal route set.

nodes.label: Global Situation Model
nodes.subject: language-tree-hub
nodes.summary: Keeps goal, constraints, resources, risk, history and stop conditions visible before action.

nodes.label: Tool Action Contract
nodes.subject: agent-tooling
nodes.summary: Normalizes every tool intent into scope, expected signal, validation, rollback and approval requirements.

nodes.label: High-frequency Pitfall Preflight
nodes.subject: agent-tooling
nodes.summary: Checks common tool failure domains before execution.

nodes.label: Agent Integration Usability Test
nodes.subject: agent-tooling
nodes.summary: Tests whether external agents can use the plugin immediately.

nodes.label: PowerShell Chinese Encoding Output
nodes.subject: powershell-safety
nodes.summary: Distinguishes display mojibake from pipe decoding and real file corruption.

nodes.label: Local Agent Connection Check
nodes.subject: agent-tooling
nodes.summary: Lets a user pick a local agent, generate config or prompt text, and confirm connection.

nodes.label: MCP Capability Discovery and Tool Boundary
nodes.subject: agent-tooling
nodes.summary: Separates MCP resources, prompts and tools, then compresses schema, permissions, side effects and scope into a pre-call boundary.

nodes.label: Guardrail and Human Review Route
nodes.subject: agent-tooling
nodes.summary: Uses guardrails and human review to block high-risk tool drift and preserve resume points.

nodes.label: Checkpoint/Store Project Memory Route
nodes.subject: agent-tooling
nodes.summary: Splits short-term state, long-term project memory and core knowledge while keeping the graph lightweight.

nodes.label: Agent-Computer Interface Engineering Loop
nodes.subject: agent-tooling
nodes.summary: Provides the repository observation, navigation, edit, test, summary and next-action loop for engineering agents.

nodes.label: CI Security and Release Hardening
nodes.subject: computer-science
nodes.summary: Checks CI permissions, secrets, third-party actions, artifact provenance and license boundaries before release.

nodes.label: PowerShell Native Command Boundary
nodes.subject: powershell-safety
nodes.summary: Reviews native command argument passing, encoding, exit code and structured evidence in PowerShell.
